title: Understanding SVD
text: In Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), the matrix X is decomposed into three matrices: U, S, and $$V^T$$. The matrix S contains the singular values on its diagonal, which represent the magnitude of the principal components.

title: Role of V in SVD
text: The matrix V in SVD contains the right singular vectors. These vectors are crucial for transforming the original data into the principal component space.

title: Calculating Latent Features
text: If Justin has the matrix X and the first two rows of V, can he compute the first two latent features for all observations?
